audit.why: Lane difficulty (TRICKY 7/10, carry threat 7.5/10) is grounded in Lux's long-range poke and point-click root shutting down Twisted Advance; content whys/spikes already state this consistently stage by stage.
Spikes at level 2 (Q+E poke lock), level 6 (Final Spark burst), first item (Q-E-R one-combo) and late (zone control) are already named with real ability names and are matchup-specific.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions from missingInteractions were absent from the page: Prismatic Barrier (W) absorbing Maokai's burst window, and Illumination's auto-attack-reset being the real combo tell rather than the ability cast.
audit.why: Both change how the owner should time an all-in — waiting out the shield and reading the auto-reset instead of the spell animation.
audit.corrected: Folded into dosFull[1].d (auto-reset tell) and dontsFull[2].d (shield absorbs burst), replacing copy-paste-bled filler that was pasted under those titles.
